item: Row 257: an absent edition total says why (R774)
summary: A refused siteinfo count read is recorded under its own history metric, so a later batch refusal never stands in for it; each edition's total carries a state (read, stale with the walk off, not read with the walk off, paused by airplane or protected mode, refused, answered without a count). R774: no new default egress; with the walk off, coverage says total not read: the page walk is off, with the switch one click away; a total read earlier is dated and no longer refreshed. SECURITY.md names the read. x12.
